Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.ghb.goa.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Goa Housing Board JE post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Junior Engineer (Civil) position at the Goa Housing Board is 21 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated office by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Engineer (Civil) post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Engineer (Civil) Group C post as per the official notification released by the Goa Housing Board.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates must download the application form, fill it out, and send it via post to the Managing Director, Goa Housing Board, Porvorim.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or State Board. Additionally, knowledge of the Konkani language is a mandatory requirement for the position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the JE post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Engineer (Civil) post is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for government servants and reserved category candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the Goa Housing Board Junior Engineer (Civil) recruitment. Candidates can submit their applications free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. Where should I send my application form?
faq.answer: The application should be sent to the Managing Director, Goa Housing Board, Building 'A', 2nd Floor, New Market Complex, Porvorim, Bardez, Goa - 403521.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this job?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Engineer (Civil) position involves the verification of essential documents submitted by the candidates along with their application forms.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates already in government service apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who are already in government service are eligible to apply, provided they send their application through the proper channel as per the official guidelines.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the application form?
faq.answer: The application format is available on the official Goa Housing Board website at www.ghb.goa.gov.in and the official government portal for candidates to download and print.
